name: io.github.index-pages/getdr-mcp
title: getdr
description: Ahrefs Domain Rating (0–100) for domains or URLs, via getdr by Index Pages

environmentVariables.name: GETDR_API
environmentVariables.description: URL of a getdr server (getdr serve). When unset, the getdr binary on PATH is used.

environmentVariables.name: GETDR_SERVE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for the getdr server, if it requires one.
